targets.rawSql: SELECT quantile(0.95)(time_to_first_audio_ms) AS value FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='tts.first_audio_queued' AND status='ok' AND time_to_first_audio_ms > 0 AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring})

panels.description: Wall time TTS was actively streaming for a turn, measured from the FIRST PCM frame to the last. It deliberately excludes the first sentence's synthesis, which happens before that first frame — so it is not end-to-end and is routinely far smaller than the actual compute. For the work performed see 'TTS model compute p95'; for what the caller waits on see 'Endpoint → first PCM queued p95'.

targets.rawSql: SELECT quantile(0.95)(duration_ms) AS value FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='tts.completed' AND status='ok' AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring})

panels.title: TTS streaming window p95 (first frame → last)

targets.rawSql: SELECT quantile(0.95)(compute_ms) AS value FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='tts.completed' AND status='ok' AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring})

SELECT quantile(0.95)(realtime_factor) AS value FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='tts.completed' AND status='ok' AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring})

SELECT toStartOfMinute(toDateTime(intDiv(event_time_ms,1000))) AS time, quantile(0.50)(time_to_first_audio_ms) AS ttfa_p50_ms, quantile(0.95)(time_to_first_audio_ms) AS ttfa_p95_ms FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='tts.first_audio_queued' AND status='ok' AND time_to_first_audio_ms > 0 AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Complete server pipeline: endpoint → first PCM queued

targets.rawSql: SELECT pipeline_version, model, engine, device, count() AS calls, round(quantile(0.95)(duration_ms),0) AS orchestration_p95_ms, round(quantile(0.95)(queue_ms),0) AS model_queue_p95_ms, round(quantile(0.95)(compute_ms),0) AS compute_p95_ms, round(quantile(0.95)(audio_seconds),2) AS audio_p95_s, round(quantile(0.95)(realtime_factor),3) AS rtf_p95, round(avg(audio_bytes)/1024,1) AS avg_pcm_kib FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='tts.completed' AND status='ok' AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring}) GROUP BY pipeline_version, model, engine, device ORDER BY calls DESC
